simple_pole_module.residue: Res_Delta(p/delta)=p, with the chosen conormal orientation
simple_pole_module.coefficient_space: H_res, the completed shell-labelled holomorphic residue carrier

hyperbolic_double.space: P_res=H_res direct-sum H_res with coordinates (pole coefficient,residue)

positive_crossing.formula: for lambda,mu in Lambda_res, [lambda,F_res mu]_(J_res)=<lambda,J_res F_res mu>=<lambda,S_res mu>=<lambda,mu>

Evans_residue.Xi_exactness: p=d_Xi(A) and vanishes on the Xi divisor, while its chain homotopy coefficient A is retained outside the positive residue norm
Evans_residue.role: the block makes the meromorphic extension positive/coherent but is not the noncollapsing Xi energy

C4_conormal_transport.parameter_exchange: if a chart sends delta to -delta, the principal coefficient coordinate changes by -1
C4_conormal_transport.residue_orientation: the oriented residue coordinate changes by the same conormal sign
C4_conormal_transport.operator: epsilon I on both hyperbolic coordinates, epsilon=+/-1, optionally multiplied by the unit Tate/metaplectic phase
C4_conormal_transport.compatibility: this scalar unitary commutes with S_res,J_res,F_res and preserves Lambda_res and its positive crossing
C4_conormal_transport.fourfold: closure reduces to the already declared product of conormal and Tate phase characters

sum_with_endpoint.endpoint_block: the stable sewing graph Clifford crossing
sum_with_endpoint.combined: orthogonal direct sum remains positive and C4-covariant because the factors carry separate typed orientations

minimality: A single residue quotient has no inherited nondegenerate Green form. Doubling it by its pole-coefficient presentation is the minimal graph construction that supplies a Lagrangian, a complementary chirality, and a positive crossing without choosing a fitted metric coefficient.
remaining_RH_gate: The residue block vanishes on Xi and only repairs relative coherence. Critical-line confinement still requires the independent arithmetic/common-bulk energy to be nonzero and its Green equation to cancel the theta forcing pairing.
conclusion: The pole-residue extension admits the same canonical Clifford mechanism as endpoint sewing. Pole coefficient and oriented residue form the positive chirality graph of a swap; Green sign times swap gives an order-four quarter-turn and an exact positive crossing. This closes the positive realization of the relative homotopy residue, but not the RH-bearing bulk balance.
